class.name: IfcTank
class.brief_description: A tank is a vessel or container in which a fluid or gas is stored for later use. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcTank defines the occurrence of any tank; common information about tank types is handled by IfcTankType .
